media.narrative_summary: A young man with glasses speaks directly to camera over screen recordings of the 'deepseek-harness' GitHub repository. On-screen text proclaims it the 'NEW FASTEST GROWING GITHUB REPO EVER.' He explains that DeepSeek recently released the Harness, an open-source AI agent framework built by DeepSeek AI. Its core design principle is that 'everything is a plugin,' powered by an architecture called Cordis. He details that this means every module — including the core agent loop itself — is compiled as a plugin that gets loaded when you start the harness. This allows users to replace or modify any part, such as the model adapter, tool registry, session log, and how transcripts interact with the system. He calls it the 'ultimate hackable agent harness' because there is no core code; every piece of code contributing to the runtime is a plugin loaded in sequence. He compares it to the Pi Agent, noting Pi has core code while DeepSeek's version is fully modular and easily modifiable due to its Cordis architecture.
